body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia**_

**Before:** the dashboard was read-only and, for you, `TAB` did not step through the menu. Separately, the `sp-splash` → `sp-dashboard` rename (#64) had merged into a stacked branch after #49 was already merged, so `main` still has `sp-splash`.

**After:**
- The rename (#64) and the `initback` removal (#65) are merged into this branch, so they reach `main`.
- Only the buttons are interactive. `sp-dashboard--isolate-menu` marks everything else (art, box lines, title, footer) `cursor-intangible`, so point can only rest on a button, and puts `sp-dashboard-mode-map` on a buffer-wide overlay, which outranks the button's own keymap. `TAB` / `S-TAB` are the same wherever point is; `RET` and a click activate the button.
- Layers: the art layers stay non-interactive (drawn into blanks); the menu is the one interactive layer.

**Checked** (Emacs 29.3, headless): `TAB` steps General agenda, Thesis, Issues, Deadlines, Config; `S-TAB` goes back; `TAB` is `sp-dashboard-next-button` and `RET` is `push-button`; the doc tangles to the `.el`. **Not checked:** a GUI, so please try `TAB` once.

**Conflicts to expect:** the other open PR that edits `sp-splash` by its old name, and CHANGELOG.org.

---
